Pierce He

Pierce He (Chinese name: 何芃晔, Pengye He) is a high school student who builds things for the web. Still working on it.

About

I'm Pierce He. I build things for the web: study tools, games and a typeface. None of it is finished, and that is what the six dots are for.

Work

Here is what there is so far. Most of it ships under Scory Studio.

Scory IB

An IB grade tracker. It turns raw scores into 1 to 7 grades, predicts a total out of 45, and writes AI reports on where the marks are heading. Teachers get a class dashboard that flags who is at risk.

For
IB Diploma students and their teachers
Inside
Grade prediction, a daily diary, a Pomodoro timer, and trackers for CAS, the Extended Essay and TOK
Plans
Free, Pro and Max for students, a Class Pack for teachers

Visit Scory IB

Celk

A study app with an attitude. Upload notes, PDFs or screenshots, and an AI tutor called K turns them into quizzes and flashcards, then keeps asking until you get them right.

For
IB, AP, university and professional courses
Inside
Flash cells, Interrogation mode, a Jailbreak exam and a Rap sheet of your weak spots
Tone
Four of them, from Kind to Unhinged
Recognition
Top 5 in a city-level AI competition, 2026

Visit Celk

Blue Scoops

Financial literacy for high schoolers. Interactive lessons, a simulated stock market that runs on virtual cash, and an AI tutor named Scoops who explains, quizzes and reviews your trades.

For
High school students who want to know how money works
Inside
Lessons, a practice market, a leaderboard, and games built on real market history
Plans
A free tier and a Plus plan

A collaborative build. Dylan / HK · Felipe / Brazil · Mia / Boston · Benedetta / Dallas

With thanks to Kwame Owusu Ansah and Victoria King at the Dartmouth Magnuson Center, and Benjamin Hansen @ Qibao Dwight High School.

Visit Blue Scoops

Type + Gradients

Two free libraries for people who build websites. One catalogs 776 font entries with filters, side-by-side comparison and CSS export. The other is a searchable shelf of CSS gradients you can copy in one click.

For
Designers and developers picking type and colour
Inside
Curated pairings, a split-screen workbench, and PNG export for gradients
Cost
Free

Open Type Library · Open Gradient Library

Games that classmates love

Three games that run in the browser, with nothing to install: a racer, a slow boat trip, and a roller coaster builder. These are the ones my classmates love.

Grand Circuit Legends
A racing game with 18 circuits and eight cars on the grid
Shallow Sea

Out of Gravity

QDSAC

Not everything I make ships. Some of it is a room full of people.

The Qibao Dwight Student AI Committee, a student-led club set up in April 2026. Its line is short: understand AI, use it responsibly, build with it. I lead it, with two faculty advisors behind us.

My role
Leader
What we run
Sharing sessions, campus surveys, workshops, and seasonal challenges that bring AI into art, code and research
So far
A school-wide AI Creation Challenge and an AI Creation Workshop, both in 2026
Building
QDHarness, a campus AI workspace for students and teachers, still in development

qdsac.scoryib.com

Activity, 2025 to 2026

  1. Oct 2025: London choral festival. Went to London to sing at the Dwight global choral festival.
  2. Apr 2026: Founded QDSAC. Started the Qibao Dwight Student AI Committee, with two faculty advisors behind us.
  3. Apr 2026: SAS AI workshop, 1st place. Invited to an AI workshop at SAS, and came away with first place.
  4. May 2026: Dwight trustees' lunch. Invited to the Dwight trustees' lunch, where I presented my AI projects to Dr. Blake Spahn of Dwight School New York.
  5. Summer 2026: Dartmouth Future Builders. A summer at Dartmouth's Future Builders program. Five of us built Blue Scoops there.
  6. Sep 2026: Student Ambassador. Became a Student Ambassador for the school.
  7. Sep 2026: Opening ceremony speech. Spoke to the whole school at the opening ceremony about Scory, Blue Scoops and what I learned at Dartmouth.
  8. Nov 2026: City AI competition, Top 5. Celk made the top five in a city-level AI competition.
  9. Nov 2026: Admissions talk. Gave the school's admissions talk to more than a hundred prospective students and parents: growing up, AI, and clubs.

About this site

Set in Scory Serif Regular, a typeface drawn by Pierce He. The page is one scroll from dawn to night: six dots taken from the letters r, f, i, j, c and y gather into an ellipsis, scatter across the work, and end as the dot in pyhe.me.
